title: Saints-Cowboys practice descends into chaos with multiple brawls — with ex-WWE star’s son in middle of it

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Saints-Cowboys practice descends into chaos with multiple brawls — with ex-WWE star’s son in middle of it
sources.description: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer wasn’t happy with his team after a joint practice with the Saints turned into “fight club,” as the bench boss described it.
